fusions.name: Shackle Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a shackle for 4 damage that then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Links Pulled Taut
fusions.desc: Yanks the chain taut around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 25% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: Reels up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
